generation_fact: A generation_fact is one atomic generation-time relation tying exact source information, the realized transformation, one concrete occurrence, the formed outcome, and the relation role; it is not merely a value or an occurrence.
generation_occurrence: A generation_occurrence identifies one concrete execution; it can realize several distinct generation facts and must not be conflated with any one fact or result.
atomic_generation_fact: Each fact preserves its own source, transformation, occurrence, outcome, and role as one atomic tuple, even when the same occurrence establishes multiple facts.
realizes_fact: realizes_fact links the exact occurrence node to a fact that occurrence established; it does not by itself replace the fact's source or outcome incidence.
reads_from: reads_from records an actual data dependency and is therefore stronger and more specific than temporal or program-order proximity.
GeneratedOrigin: GeneratedOrigin records that an outcome formed earlier participates as an exact source in a later generation fact.
program_order: program_order records declared execution order only; it does not establish reads_from, formation, or another data dependency by itself.
equal_values: Equal numeric values or equal outputs do not identify equal facts, occurrences, sources, results, or formation histories.
cartesian_recombination: Facts realized by an occurrence must remain atomic and must never be decomposed into source and result sets and recombined by Cartesian product.
missing_relations: A missing relation means it was not established in the graph; absence does not automatically prove the relation false, and absence of a concurrency edge does not prove concurrency.
forward_query: A forward training query follows exact identities and primitive relations from training sample through batch occurrence, forward occurrence, loss, backward occurrence, gradient, optimizer occurrence, and the new parameter version; every derived link must state its traversal rule.
reverse_query: A reverse query begins at the exact evaluation or parameter result and traverses its actual reads_from, GeneratedOrigin, realizes_fact, and incidence relations; timestamp proximity and numeric similarity are not substitutes.
executable_claim: The sealed executable mechanism is the scientific claim because it must initialize from an allowed prefix and generate an unseen continuous execution without reading the future; the report explains and cites the mechanism but cannot replace it.
state_sufficiency: A proposed state q is operationally closed only when equal or sufficiently similar (q, declared input) cases do not yield materially incompatible next states or outcomes under the required tolerance; divergent futures, evolving omitted variables, or unproducible transitions require revising or enlarging the state.
prefix_only_falsification: Before sealing, replay multiple cuts before, near, and after proposed transitions: expose only each prefix, initialize from it, predict a withheld suffix without reading it, compare prospectively, retain failures, and revise or reject the candidate rather than relying on a full-run fit.
report_code_correspondence: Every forecast-relevant report claim must map from exact primitive GFG evidence to an executable state field or justified elimination and to an exact update-law location; every field must have a defined update or be a prefix-derived frozen constant.
operational_state_use: Field presence, serialization, or reporting is not operational use: for each claimed controlling field, identify the expression through which it changes a required forecast and perturb, remove, or hold it fixed in prefix-only replay; fields with no effect are diagnostics, not mechanism state.
intervention_state_audit: For an intervention, enumerate every state read or written by the affected operation, determine what the hook changes, freezes, or leaves evolving, propagate all differences through the same executable update law, and test discovery prefixes where possible; holding one visible quantity need not hold hidden state or imply pure time translation.
cross_run_invariance: A repeated fixed period, amplitude, rate, increment, threshold, or timing pattern in one run is only a hypothesis: separate structural law, prefix-inferred state, estimated parameters, and uncertainty; use matched compressed-state/input cases and multiple prospective prefix cuts to seek divergent futures, and treat within-run survival only as non-falsification until the sealed mechanism is tested on a distinct unseen continuous execution.
